findings.title: Early-pass events dispatched before page handlers bind are lost; authoritative pass treats the field as unchanged and never replays them
findings.fix: Record pre-write values in-page (window.__nzwhEarly) during the early pass; in the authoritative pass restore them without events (restoreEarly arg) so every early-written field is re-decided and re-written on the settled DOM (posting -> legacy). Add jQuery.isReady to SECTION_DOM_READY_JS. Fixtures for onload-bound show/hide and onload-bound __doPostBack; B12 row.

findings.title: Documents reached via a postback inside the authoritative pass are decided at DOMContentLoaded
findings.fix: When legacyFillField changes timeOrigin in the authoritative pass, return 'postback'; outer loop settles and restarts the authoritative pass (bounded by entries.length, not counted as unexpected reload). Update B11; fixtures for onload-shown clear and onload reset on a postback response page.

findings.title: Early pass sends server postbacks before the first document's load handlers run
findings.location: B5 runPass early 'posting' branch, B6, B11, B12
findings.fix: In the early pass a 'posting' stop ends the pass; posting fields are handled only by the authoritative pass on the settled DOM. Update B11; fixture asserting a load-set hidden input reaches the server.

findings.title: Resume guard throws in the early pass, contradicting 'early missing/unavailable-required is never fatal'
findings.location: B5 pseudocode vs rationale bullets and B9
findings.fix: In the early pass, exceeding MAX_FIELD_RESUMES defers (index = i + 1); only the authoritative pass throws. Unit test.

findings.title: REMOTE_TRIGGER regex escaping changes when moved into a String.raw constant
findings.fix: Use single backslashes in String.raw; vm-evaluated unit test covering __doPostBack, WebForm_DoPostBack, form.submit(), fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon.

findings.title: CAPTCHA load wait can be silent up to 30 s and ignores a disappearing challenge
findings.fix: Keep readyState read first per iteration; then break when !captchaPending(driver). Add a captcha-load-wait test.
